job.resolved_prompt:
If a resolver could not resolve a name, there's currently no way to report error back to ClientConn, and RPCs on the ClientConn will fail with timeout.

This method allows resolver to report error to ClientConn, and failfast RPCs should fail with this error (or RPC errors that contain info from this error).
followups: When name resolution fails, propagate that failure to the ClientConn so fail-fast RPCs can return a resolution error instead of waiting until timeout. Preserve normal behavior when valid resolver state arrives.

Extend the balancer update contract to report whether resolver state is usable, and provide balancers a callback for resolver errors. Add resolver.ClientConn.ReportError and ParseServiceConfig, represent parsed service config as a serviceconfig.ParseResult containing Config or Err, and use ErrBadResolverState to request resolution retries.

Carry resolver errors from resolver.ClientConn.ReportError through the ClientConn and serialized balancer wrapper; let UpdateClientConnState return an error and add ResolverError(error). Define balancer.ErrBadResolverState for unusable address or service-config state. On bad state, surface an Unavailable picker error when there is no usable prior/default config, retain a usable prior/default config when available, and poll ResolveNow with exponential backoff until good state arrives or the resolver closes. Stop polling on recovery/close, serialize resolver and balancer callbacks, and signal the first-resolve event even on error paths.
